CreateAppBlbIpGroup.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string up to 64 characters
CreateAppBlbIpGroup.name: Name of the IP group. 1–65 bytes, must start with a letter, may contain letters, digits, -, /, ., _. Auto-generated if omitted
CreateAppBlbIpGroup.desc: Description of the IP group, max 200 characters
CreateAppBlbIpGroup.preserveClientIpEnabled: Whether to enable client IP preservation. Defaults to true. Disabling is only supported when groupTargetType is same-region same-VPC mode. Note: only supported on application-type instances; not supported on application-type IPv6.
CreateAppBlbIpGroup.groupTargetType: Traffic mode for the IP group. Defaults to customized. Allowed values: sameVpc (same region, same VPC), acrossVpc (same region, cross VPC), acrossRegion (cross region), hybridCloud (hybrid cloud), customized (custom). Note: the IP group traffic mode cannot be modified after creation.
CreateAppBlbIpGroup.memberList: List of IP members attached to the IP group
